# NRDC (Natural Resources Defense Council)

> NRDC is a leading nonprofit environmental advocacy organization fighting the climate crisis and defending natural resources through policy, litigation, and community action.

The Natural Resources Defense Council (NRDC) combines scientific expertise, legal advocacy, and grassroots mobilization to address environmental challenges including climate change, public lands protection, endangered species conservation, and community health. With work spanning from local communities like Flint, Michigan to international efforts in India and Venezuela, NRDC influences environmental policy at federal, state, and local levels.
